                                      9.1 · 9. CKAD labs

                                      Zero-downtime rolling update

                                      TASK · namespace jahez-lab

                                      Create Deployment menu-web-deployment with 4 replicas of nginx:1.27, a readiness probe on / port 80, and a strategy that never has fewer than 4 available Pods and never more than 5. Then update it to nginx:1.27-alpine and wait for it to finish.

                                      Show solution
                                      What you will build
                                      Commands
                                      solution.shbash
                                      kubectl create namespace jahez-lab
kubectl -n jahez-lab create deployment menu-web-deployment --image=nginx:1.27 --replicas=4 --dry-run=client -o yaml > lab1-web.yaml
# edit: add strategy, minReadySeconds and readinessProbe (see the YAML), then:
kubectl -n jahez-lab apply -f lab1-web.yaml
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout status deploy/menu-web-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-lab set image deploy/menu-web-deployment web=nginx:1.27-alpine
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout status deploy/menu-web-deployment
                                      Full YAML
                                      lab1-web.yamlkubectl apply -f
                                      apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: menu-web-deployment
  namespace: jahez-lab
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: menu-web
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  minReadySeconds: 5
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: menu-web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:1.27
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            periodSeconds: 3
                                      Verify
                                      verify.shbash
                                      kubectl -n jahez-lab get deploy menu-web-deployment -o jsonpath='{.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate}{"\n"}'
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout history deploy/menu-web-deployment
                                      Expected · example output
                                      {"maxSurge":1,"maxUnavailable":0}
REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
1         <none>
2         <none>
                                      Exam traps
                                      • kubectl create deployment names the container after the image (nginx); the YAML here renames it web, so set image must use web=.
                                      • Both 0 for surge and unavailable is invalid.
                                      9.2 · 9. CKAD labs

                                      Roll back to a specific revision

                                      TASK · namespace jahez-lab

                                      On menu-web-deployment, create revisions with images nginx:1.25 and then nginx:1.26, each with a change-cause. Then return to the revision that ran nginx:1.27-alpine without guessing its number.

                                      Show solution
                                      What you will build
                                      Commands
                                      solution.shbash
                                      kubectl -n jahez-lab set image deploy/menu-web-deployment web=nginx:1.25
kubectl -n jahez-lab annotate deploy/menu-web-deployment kubernetes.io/change-cause="nginx 1.25" --overwrite
kubectl -n jahez-lab set image deploy/menu-web-deployment web=nginx:1.26
kubectl -n jahez-lab annotate deploy/menu-web-deployment kubernetes.io/change-cause="nginx 1.26" --overwrite
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout history deploy/menu-web-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout history deploy/menu-web-deployment --revision=2 | grep Image
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout undo deploy/menu-web-deployment --to-revision=2
                                      Verify
                                      verify.shbash
                                      kubectl -n jahez-lab get deploy menu-web-deployment -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}'
kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout history deploy/menu-web-deployment
                                      Expected · example output
                                      nginx:1.27-alpine
REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
1         <none>
3         nginx 1.25
4         nginx 1.26
5         <none>
                                      Exam traps
                                      • Revision 2 disappears from the list: undo moved it to 5.
                                      • Annotate after each change; the annotation is copied to the ReplicaSet of the revision being created.

                                      Pause, change twice, resume

                                      TASK · namespace jahez-lab

                                      On menu-web-deployment, change the image to nginx:1.27 and add env MENU_LAYOUT=grid so that only one new revision is created.

                                      Show solution
                                      What you will build

                                      solution.shbash
                                      kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout pause deploy/menu-web-deployment

kubectl -n jahez-lab rollout resume deploy/menu-web-deployment

                                      9.6 · 9. CKAD labs

                                      Recreate for a single indexer

                                      TASK · namespace jahez-lab

                                      Deployment menu-indexer-deployment must never run two Pods at once, even during an update. Create it with busybox:1.36, then update the command and prove there was no overlap.

                                      Show solution
                                      What you will build

                                      solution.shbash

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: menu-indexer-deployment
  namespace: jahez-lab
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: menu-indexer
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: menu-indexer
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: indexer
          image: busybox:1.36
          command:
            - "sh"
            - "-c"
            - "echo indexing; sleep 3600"

                                      kubectl -n jahez-lab get deploy menu-indexer-deployment -o jsonpath='{.spec.strategy}{"\n"}'

                                      {"type":"Recreate"}
                                      Exam traps
                                      • Changing an existing RollingUpdate Deployment to Recreate needs rollingUpdate: null in a patch, or the API rejects the leftover block.
                                      10.1 · 10. Checklist and cheat sheet

                                      Best-practice checklist

                                      ✓ Always

                                      • A real readiness probe that checks Postgres, Redis and Elasticsearch.
                                      • resources.requests so the scheduler can place surge Pods.
                                      • maxUnavailable: 0 + maxSurge: 1 for customer-facing services.
                                      • preStop: sleep 5 + terminationGracePeriodSeconds.
                                      • topologySpreadConstraints across me-central-1a/b/c.
                                      • progressDeadlineSeconds so stuck rollouts fail loudly.
                                      • A kubernetes.io/change-cause on every release.

                                      ✕ Avoid

                                      • Recreate on anything users touch.
                                      • Rolling out with no readiness probe.
                                      • Shadowing into shared stateful dependencies.
                                      • Blue/Green without budgeting 2× capacity.
                                      • :latest tags: pin immutable versions.
                                      • revisionHistoryLimit: 0.
                                      • Applying two strategy folders for the same app at once.
                                      10.2 · 10. Checklist and cheat sheet

                                      kubectl cheat sheet

                                      deploy-cheatsheet.shreference
                                      # ── trigger & watch ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod set image deploy/menu-service-deployment menu=ghcr.io/jahez/menu-service:v2.4.0
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout status  deploy/menu-service-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout pause   deploy/menu-service-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout resume  deploy/menu-service-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout restart deploy/menu-service-deployment
# ── inspect ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod get deploy menu-service-deployment -o wide
kubectl -n jahez-prod get rs -l app=menu-service                  # old + new ReplicaSets
kubectl -n jahez-prod get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=menu-service
kubectl -n jahez-prod describe deploy menu-service-deployment | grep -A4 StrategyType
# ── replica-ratio canary ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod scale deploy/menu-canary-deployment --replicas=2
kubectl -n jahez-prod scale deploy/menu-stable-deployment --replicas=0   # promote
# ── blue/green flip ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod patch svc menu-active-service --type merge -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"menu-service","version":"green"}}}'
# ── rollback ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout history deploy/menu-service-deployment
kubectl -n jahez-prod rollout undo    deploy/menu-service-deployment --to-revision=6
# ── tune the window live ──
kubectl -n jahez-prod patch deploy menu-service-deployment -p '{"spec":{"strategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"maxSurge":2,"maxUnavailable":0}}}}'
# ── Argo Rollouts ──
kubectl argo rollouts -n jahez-prod get rollout menu-rollout --watch
kubectl argo rollouts -n jahez-prod promote menu-rollout
kubectl argo rollouts -n jahez-prod abort   menu-rollout
